mechanism_narrative: A strong increase in GDP indicates a growing economy, which leads to higher consumer spending and increased demand for goods and services, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative during periods of strong GDP growth, or the correlation between GDP and S&P 500 returns is not significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate below 4% signals an easing monetary policy, leading to increased borrowing and spending, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher during periods of low federal funds rates (t-test p > 0.05), or the federal funds rate does not lead to increased borrowing and spending.

mechanism_narrative: A low unemployment rate indicates a strong labor market, which leads to increased consumer spending and economic growth, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative during periods of low unemployment, or the correlation between unemployment and S&P 500 returns is not significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts indicates increased demand for housing, which leads to higher economic growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher during periods of high housing starts (t-test p > 0.05), or housing starts do not lead to increased economic growth.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production indicates increased supply, which leads to higher economic growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days, but only when the federal funds rate is low.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher during periods of high industrial production and low federal funds rates (t-test p > 0.05), or the interaction between industrial production and federal funds rate does not lead to increased economic growth.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the consumer price index indicates low inflation, which leads to increased consumer spending and economic growth, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher during periods of low consumer price index (t-test p > 0.05), or the consumer price index does not lead to increased consumer spending.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in payroll employment indicates a strong labor market, which leads to increased consumer spending and economic growth, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days, but only when the unemployment rate is low.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher during periods of high payroll employment and low unemployment (t-test p > 0.05), or the interaction between payroll employment and unemployment rate does not lead to increased economic growth.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in retail sales indicates increased demand, which leads to higher economic growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, but only when the federal funds rate is high.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower during periods of high retail sales and high federal funds rates (t-test p > 0.05), or the interaction between retail sales and federal funds rate does not lead to decreased economic growth.
